video_title: Bogdan Bogdanović on The NBA Culture Shock, Surviving Partizan, & Playing 3-on-5!

quotes.speaker: Bogdan Bogdanović
quotes.summary_phrase: Bogdan Bogdanović on the intensity and importance of every game
quotes.excerpt: Every game is important and everybody likes winning.
quotes.quote: Every game is important and everybody likes winning.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Recalling the 3-on-5 game between Partizan and Red Star

quotes.speaker: Bogdan Bogdanović
quotes.summary_phrase: Bogdan Bogdanović on the pressure of playing in front of rival fans
quotes.excerpt: They won game 1 in our court, but we were scared to show up in front of their fans.
quotes.quote: They won game 1 in our court, but we were scared to show up in front of their fans. They'll be the topic. They're going to make the story up.

quotes.speaker: Bogdan Bogdanović
quotes.summary_phrase: Bogdan Bogdanović clarifies his MVP and individual awards in Europe
quotes.excerpt: I didn't win MVP. I won EuroLeague. MVP of Final Four was Ekpe Udoh.
quotes.quote: No, I didn't win MVP. I won EuroLeague. MVP of Final Four was Ekpe Udoh, and MVP of a regular season, Sergio Llull.

quotes.speaker: Bogdan Bogdanović
quotes.summary_phrase: Bogdan Bogdanović on the uncertainty of a professional basketball career
quotes.excerpt: You never know when it's going to be your last game.
quotes.quote: You never know when it's going to be your last game, when it's going to be your last chance to prove something or win something.

quotes.speaker: Bogdan Bogdanović
quotes.summary_phrase: Bogdan Bogdanović on the importance of team chemistry over individual stats
quotes.excerpt: I learned during that time being with national team that it is not about winning. It's building together.
quotes.quote: I learned during that time being with national team that it is not about winning. It's building together towards something. We always had a goal. I remember my first national team was with Duško Vujošević. That first experience, I see how much the chemistry of the team is important for the team success.

quotes.speaker: Bogdan Bogdanović
quotes.summary_phrase: Bogdan Bogdanović on the trust and confidence required in high-stakes games
quotes.excerpt: When it's a war time, when you step on the floor, you don't have fear.
quotes.quote: When it's a war time, when you step on the floor, you don't have fear. You don't have an untrusted person next to you. If somebody hits you on the floor, there is some dirty plays, you know, you know your guys got your back.

quotes.speaker: Bogdan Bogdanović
quotes.summary_phrase: Bogdan Bogdanović on his dedication to the process of improvement
quotes.excerpt: I love the process of getting better.
quotes.quote: I love the process of getting better. It's simple as that.

quotes.speaker: Bogdan Bogdanović
quotes.summary_phrase: Bogdan Bogdanović on shooting as an offensive weapon that dictates game flow
quotes.excerpt: Shooting is not just shooting. You use it as an offensive weapon.
quotes.quote: Shooting is not just shooting. You use it as an offensive weapon. That's where the game breaks down and slows down. The guys are going to close out, run you off the free throw line. What are the next options? Then you have to develop passing from shooting.

quotes.speaker: Bogdan Bogdanović
quotes.summary_phrase: Bogdan Bogdanović on Zeljko Obradovic's ability to manage player egos
quotes.excerpt: Zeljko is good for winning. He is good in managing that ego.
quotes.quote: Zeljko is good for winning. He is good in managing that ego, you know, when you bring those players from certain teams and they all think they're the best. And how to build that team together with three, four guys that are thinking that's their team.

quotes.speaker: Bogdan Bogdanović
quotes.summary_phrase: Bogdan Bogdanović on Zeljko Obradovic's coaching philosophy regarding star players
quotes.excerpt: Greatest players will wait for the game to come to them.
quotes.quote: He was always saying like, greatest players will wait for the game to come to them. They're not going score 20, score 15, because they're the great player.

quotes.speaker: Bogdan Bogdanović
quotes.summary_phrase: Bogdan Bogdanović on the importance of team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: Best players will be best players. We talk about it all the time.
quotes.quote: Best players will be best players. We talk about it all the time.

quotes.speaker: Bogdan Bogdanović
quotes.summary_phrase: Bogdan Bogdanović on the value of competitive league experience
quotes.excerpt: Every game is important and everybody likes winning.
quotes.quote: Every game is important and everybody likes winning. Importance of those games gives you experience for national team when that big game comes.

quotes.speaker: Bogdan Bogdanović
quotes.summary_phrase: Bogdan Bogdanović on the high standards of the Partizan basketball school
quotes.excerpt: If you make it out of Partizan, you can play wherever.
quotes.quote: If you make it out of Partizan, you can play wherever.

quotes.speaker: Bogdan Bogdanović
quotes.summary_phrase: Bogdan Bogdanović on the team-oriented nature of European basketball
quotes.excerpt: European basketball is still more team-oriented.
quotes.quote: European basketball is still more team-oriented. NBA is more superstar-oriented.

quotes.speaker: Bogdan Bogdanović
quotes.summary_phrase: Bogdan Bogdanović on his work ethic during recovery
quotes.excerpt: Whatever I was doing, I have to do it more.
quotes.quote: Whatever I was doing, I have to do it more.

quotes.speaker: Bogdan Bogdanović
quotes.summary_phrase: Bogdan Bogdanović on the feeling of winning
quotes.excerpt: Winning is the best feeling ever.
quotes.quote: Winning is the best feeling ever.
